name: move
description: Move one joint by a signed model angle relative to current, calibrated home, or absolute model zero.

name: pose
description: Move several joints together; each angle pairs with the same-index joint.

name: oscillate
description: Move a joint back and forth around its starting angle for complete cycles, returning to that angle.

name: hold
description: Hold the preceding target for the requested duration.

name: gait
description: Use the existing P4 walking system when ordinary locomotion is requested.

name: stop
description: Stop body movement when stopping is requested.

name: feet
description: Translate the listed foot reference points together from their measured starting positions. Each offset_mm corresponds to the leg at the same index. Robot frame: X forward, Y left, Z up. Leave other foot targets unchanged. Advance on measured arrival; speed_pct sets the joint travel rate.

name: body
description: Change body translation and roll/pitch/yaw from the starting pose. Keep foot reference points fixed unless a listed foot_offsets_mm explicitly moves them too. The foot offsets use the starting robot frame and pair with legs. Translations are millimetres, rotations are degrees about X/Y/Z; speed_pct sets the joint travel rate. These are geometric targets, not claims that feet are touching the floor.

name: release
description: Release servo outputs when the request explicitly asks to release them, including after resting.

name: face
description: Show an existing robot face immediately. Gesture cues animate during the current program, then the normal body face resumes. A face-only program uses the normal face selection lifetime until replacement or a body motion revision. This operation does not move joints or wait.
